package domain

import "regexp"

const (
	MaxSafeValidationStages   = 100
	MaxSafeValidationIssues   = 100
	SafeSemanticIssueMessage  = "A validation criterion was not satisfied. Review this stage and try again."
	SafeTechnicalIssueMessage = "Validation could not be completed because of a technical problem. Retry validation."
	SafeSkippedIssueMessage   = "This validation stage did not run."
	SafePassedIssueMessage    = "This validation stage passed."
)

// Stage IDs and issue codes are trusted technical identifiers, never prose,
// paths or provider messages. Invalid values use a fixed safe placeholder.
var safeValidationIdentifier = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$`)

type ValidationSummary struct {
	ValidationRunID     string            `json:"validation_run_id"`
	Outcome             ValidationOutcome `json:"outcome"`
	ErrorClassification *string           `json:"error_classification"`
	Stages              []ValidationStage `json:"stages"`
}

func KnownValidationErrorClassification(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT", "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE", "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL", "STAGE_EXECUTION_ERROR", "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", "SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT", "SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION", "AUTHORING_DEFECT":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func safeIdentifier(value, fallback string) string {
	if safeValidationIdentifier.MatchString(value) {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

// NewSafeValidationSummary retains only the existing safe result contract.
// Provider messages are intentionally never copied, even if they look safe.
func NewSafeValidationSummary(runID string, result ValidationResult) *ValidationSummary {
	summary := &ValidationSummary{ValidationRunID: runID, Outcome: result.Outcome, Stages: make([]ValidationStage, 0)}
	if result.Outcome == OutcomeError {
		classification := result.ErrorClassification
		if !KnownValidationErrorClassification(classification) {
			classification = "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL"
		}
		summary.ErrorClassification = &classification
	}
	for index, stage := range result.Stages {
		if index == MaxSafeValidationStages {
			break
		}
		safe := ValidationStage{StageID: safeIdentifier(stage.StageID, "validation-stage"), Required: stage.Required, Outcome: stage.Outcome, Issues: make([]ValidationIssue, 0)}
		message := SafeTechnicalIssueMessage
		switch stage.Outcome {
		case "PASS":
			message = SafePassedIssueMessage
		case "FAIL":
			message = SafeSemanticIssueMessage
		case "ERROR":
		case "SKIPPED":
			message = SafeSkippedIssueMessage
		default:
			safe.Outcome = "ERROR"
		}
		for issueIndex, issue := range stage.Issues {
			if issueIndex == MaxSafeValidationIssues {
				break
			}
			safe.Issues = append(safe.Issues, ValidationIssue{Code: safeIdentifier(issue.Code, "VALIDATION_ISSUE"), Message: message})
		}
		summary.Stages = append(summary.Stages, safe)
	}
	return summary
}

// CurrentSafeValidationSummary rejects legacy, stale and nonterminal detail.
// It returns a detached sanitized copy so projections cannot mutate history.
func (submission Submission) CurrentSafeValidationSummary() *ValidationSummary {
	if len(submission.ValidationRuns) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	run := submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1]
	summary := run.SafeSummary
	if summary == nil || !IsCanonicalUUID(run.ID) || summary.ValidationRunID != run.ID || summary.Outcome != run.Outcome {
		return nil
	}
	switch run.Status {
	case ValidationRunPassed:
		if run.Outcome != OutcomePass {
			return nil
		}
	case ValidationRunFailed:
		if run.Outcome != OutcomeFail {
			return nil
		}
	case ValidationRunError:
		if run.Outcome != OutcomeError {
			return nil
		}
	default:
		return nil
	}
	if run.Outcome == OutcomeError {
		if !KnownValidationErrorClassification(run.ErrorClassification) || summary.ErrorClassification == nil || *summary.ErrorClassification != run.ErrorClassification {
			return nil
		}
	} else if run.ErrorClassification != "" || summary.ErrorClassification != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return NewSafeValidationSummary(run.ID, ValidationResult{Outcome: run.Outcome, ErrorClassification: run.ErrorClassification, Stages: summary.Stages})
}
